Which of these the merge's tree keeps is measured at P3 and is P4's (the coupled-pin rule below).
  - **Each commit left out is named with its reason** — in a two-parent merge a left-out commit is still an ancestor, so "left out" means its change is undone in the merge's tree; each such undo is listed with its reason, and the earlier left-out table (`res-7qgqygtj`, 102 at `e5305a4c1`) is re-read row by row against `547d7514b`: a reason that no longer holds puts the commit back in.

- **`position: sticky` (blitz#887) — whether it is in the take [inferred]:** `git log -i --grep=sticky HEAD..upstream/main` finds no commit; `git log -S'Position::Sticky' HEAD..upstream/main -- packages` finds one, `f9d0e8c76` «Paint positioned descendants of static boxes with their positioned ancestor (#1445)», a paint-order change. P3 confirms against the commits touching scroll and paint.

- **The CDP listener's security amendment first [inferred]:** `a1670ef1b` «Add Chrome DevTools Protocol server (#572)» is an ancestor of `upstream/main` and is in the delta, with its follow-ups (`5a486f629`, `ad130c16a`, `2c929697a`, `2ee31e656` among them) and the workspace member `packages/blitz-vibey-cdp-server`. Per `res-ipcah32k` its served listener (`127.0.0.1` via `BLITZ_CDP_PORT`) needs a security-plan amendment (arch §Occupied Resources and the security plan's surfaces) before any take that brings it lands. Whether the merge keeps the crate, and the listener, is a boundary widening and so the founder's fork.

- **Conflicts are measured at P3** on a fresh trial worktree under `target/tmp/`, with `git -c rerere.enabled=false`. Every resolution keeps both sides' intent: the changed set's contract, the clock invariant, the select model and its list, the hit stops and the scrolled-box bounds, the reversed scroll origins and the into-view readings, the stable ids and the snapshot, the range and keyboard models, `inert`, the accessibility state reads, the stamped sub-resource request and the `file:` refusal, the buffered render, and the escher crates and seven_guis members of the workspace. No workaround is bought only to keep upstream code untouched (the operator's standing rule): where staying additive would force contorted logic, the upstream code is changed and the change says so.
- **Upstream's new and edited test files** run under this fork's blitz-tests rule: one file and one target per behaviour, pinned by `.github/scripts/test_blitz_tests_targets.py`.

- **Every escher proof still passes after the merge:** `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast` and `doc`; the stand checks in both layout modes; the incremental/non-incremental oracle; the a11y leg and the dependency audit; the `embolden` witness; the screenshot and cross-OS readings (a moved reading is re-measured and recorded, never loosened); fork CI green on the pushed commit, every job settled.

- **CI:** upstream `ci.yml:203` `uses: nttld/setup-ndk@v1` — a tag, not a 40-hex SHA (confirmed).

- **Engine changes for every document:** (1) queued DOM events, `clear_focus` / `set_focus_to` firing blur, focusout, focus, focusin (upstream `document.rs:1821`, `:1847`, confirmed) — against the ratified «the clear firing no DOM `blur` or `focusout`» (inert) and «no DOM focus events on a single select»; (2) script-dispatched events read `isTrusted = false` (upstream `blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/event.rs:243-244`, confirmed) — against «every runtime event has `isTrusted = true`»; (3) a `preventDefault`ed mouse pointerup still clicks (`2f8623555`); (4) SVG presentation attributes (`ea7cfe0e3`, about 45 names, typed parse) and `hr` `color`/`noshade`/`size` (`fb381be2c`) read as hints, whether an SVG `mask="url(…)"` reaches the mask fetch unmeasured; (5) `visibility: collapse` leaves the accessibility tree and so the snapshot (`5b8e7a268`).

data.head: # Plan — 2026-11-19-upstream-sync-ahead-of-the-debts: "Upstream sync ahead of the debts"

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase P4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not
edit during an /implement run._
- **Marker:** 2026-11-19-upstream-sync-ahead-of-the-debts · **Version:** escher-0.4.0

Merge DioxusLabs/blitz `upstream/main` at `547d7514ba2adb357d41d5e4655a63ddd5cdc5ec` into `build/escher-0.4.0` as a real two-parent merge — never a rebase, a squash or a cherry-pick series (inputs#I1; intent finding 2) — with every escher behaviour intact and proven by our own checks and CI, every upstream commit whose change the merge's tree does not keep named with its reason, and every boundary widening the merge brings decided by the founder before it lands (inputs#I1; playbook `rul-72xhfjoz`; `(architecture · decision/upstream-behaviour-changes-ratified-per-take)`). It is the first such merge since `3eda07bc8` (base `23b9b26a9`): the 0.3.0 takes were cherry-picks folded into squashed commits, so the merge meets their content as duplicate edits (research §The trial merge: 52 conflicted files, 164 hunks).

The merge takes upstream's coupled registry set Stylo 0.24 · selectors 0.43 · parley 0.13 · skrifa 0.49 · winit `=0.31.0-beta.4` · svgtypes 0.16.2, with arboard leaving for winit's clipboard, and holds Dioxus at 0.7.3 (leaned below). It keeps escher's surfaces as the masters state them: the stamped sub-resource request and the `file:` refusal `(security-plan · decision/one-stamping-request-constructor)`, the ratified changed set `(security-plan · decision/accessibility-tree-refresh-on-change)`, the select, range, keyboard and `inert` models, the accessibility state reads, the buffered render on the 0.7 bridge `(test-plan · decision/buffered-render-on-dioxus-07-bridge)`, the stable ids, snapshot, UI graph and reached record, one blitz-tests target per file `(test-plan · decision/blitz-tests-one-target-per-file)`, every action SHA-pinned `(security-plan · decision/ci-actions-pinned-to-sha)`, no git dependency beyond Taffy's pin `(security-plan · decision/no-git-dependency)` unless the founder rules W2 B. `position: sticky` (blitz#887) is not in the take (research §Sticky): a sticky box stays laid out as relative.

**Blocked on the founder's word:** steps 4–5 read the founder's answers to W1–W9 of `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-19-upstream-sync-ahead-of-the-debts/evidence/founder-forks.md`, relayed by the operator and snapped (`inputs.py snap --step implement`). /implement starts only with those answers in the chunk's inputs; steps 1–3 and 6–12 do not depend on them except where a step names the fork.

1. **Preconditions.** The worktree holds no tracked change outside `.andromeda/` and `.claude/session-handoff.md` (the wrap's bookkeeping). Remove the trial worktree P3 made: `git worktree remove --force target/tmp/trial-debts` (escher's own, unresolved, never committed). Read the founder's answers (inputs) for W1–W9; any fork unanswered → stop before step 3.

2. **Pin the merge's upstream side.** `git fetch upstream`; the merge names the commit `547d7514ba2adb357d41d5e4655a63ddd5cdc5ec`, never the moving `upstream/main` (a later upstream commit is the next sync's).

3. **Start the merge.** `git -c rerere.enabled=false merge --no-commit --no-ff 547d7514ba2adb357d41d5e4655a63ddd5cdc5ec` on `build/escher-0.4.0`. It exits 1 with the conflicts research measured; `MERGE_HEAD` stands until the operator's pre-CI commit, which records the two parents. /implement never commits.

4. **Resolve the conflicts, class by class** (evidence/collisions-survey.md §Task 1 lists each file's class):
   - **Duplicates** (the AnyRender `AntiAliasing` call sites in blitz-paint and the other picks made twice): upstream's form where both sides mean the same change; escher's additions in the same hunk kept (the password mask, the select list paint `paint_select_list` order and colours).
   - **The manifest and lock** (`Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `apps/browser/Cargo.toml`, `packages/dioxus-native/Cargo.toml`): upstream's pins for the coupled set above; the Dioxus lines held at `0.7.3`; the escher members (`packages/escher-telemetry`, `packages/escher-driver`) and the `seven_guis` path dependency kept; `homepage`/`repository` escher's; members `packages/blitz-vibey-cdp-server` per W1 and `packages/parley_code_editor` per W2. The lock starts from upstream's and is brought to the ruled set by one unlocked `cargo check --workspace` (no `cargo update`), then read name by name (step 9).
   - **Dioxus held at 0.7.3:** the dioxus-native and dioxus-native-dom files restored to escher's side wherever upstream's change is `286874cc1`'s 0.8 port — the clean takes too (`mutation_writer.rs`, `events.rs`, the `keyboard_compat.rs` delete) — so `element_id.rs`'s stable-id walk, `mutation_buffer.rs` and the harness's `vdom_alone` stand on 0.7.3 as at HEAD; a later upstream edit there that does not need 0.8 is kept, one that does is undone and named (step 9).
   - **Stylo 0.24:** `packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs` (modify/delete) resolves to upstream's `stylo/` split with escher's edits carried into the matching submodule — the `multiple` select `size` hint into `stylo/presentational_hints.rs` — and `init_stylo_prefs` set once with escher's pref set under the 0.24 names `(architecture · decision/stylo-prefs-set-once)`; `ac6f9f582` (`background-clip: text`) and `6491729c5` (opsz) enter with it.
   - **The event queue** (`5d4a1f7b2`, `2c76b3f3c`, `b4ad543de`) into `packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs`, `keyboard.rs`, `document.rs`, `mutator.rs`: upstream's `queue_event` / `queue_ua_event` taken; `handle_click`'s change re-applied by hand to the `click_*` arm functions (`res-vuvpa25q`); the keyboard activation, select keys and typeahead, range keys and the open-list keys kept as escher's; the focus events per W5; the cancelled-pointerup click per W7.
   - **Change tracking** (`be60597f6`): escher's `changed_nodes` / `take_changed_nodes` kept; upstream's `has_changes` / `clear_changes` and its shell refresh (`packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs`) read from the changed set, so `View::poll`, the snapshot diff and upstream's refresh agree.
   - **Floats** (`aa983ec7c` and its chain, `layout/inline/layout.rs`, `layout/inline/build.rs` add/add): upstream's placement taken, `place_floated_box` as upstream now writes it (`res-derughab`).
   - **Accessibility** (`accessibility.rs`): escher's builder kept (the closed-set state reads, the trimmed `aria-label`, the toggle per role, the focus filter, `inert`, the select); `visibility: collapse` per W9.
   - **Net and script** (`blitz-dom/src/net.rs`, `blitz-net/src/lib.rs`, `blitz-vibey-script/src/fetch.rs`, `runtime/events.rs` add/add): the stamped request with its initiator and `FileForbidden` kept; `f0d7aeac9`'s `@import` refusal applied through `stamped_request`, its test given the document URL; the runtime's checkbox/radio `change` synthesis stays deleted; `isTrusted` per W6.
   - **Tests** (`tests/blitz-tests/tests/*.rs` conflicts, `all.rs`): both sides' assertions kept; `all.rs` takes upstream's `mod` lines and stays `test = false`.
   - **CI** (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `wpt.yml`): upstream's edits kept; `nttld/setup-ndk@v1` pinned to the 40-hex SHA its tag names (`gh api repos/nttld/setup-ndk/git/ref/tags/v1`, the ref kept as a trailing comment); `contents: read`, every `github.repository` guard and every `--locked` kept.
   - **Files of ours upstream also touched:** `README.md` escher's `(architecture · decision/readme-is-escher-own)`; `AGENTS.md` removed from the merge's tree `(architecture · decision/upstream-agents-md-excluded)`; `examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/cells.rs`, `examples/custom_widget.rs`, `examples/screenshot.rs`, `examples/wgpu_texture/src/demo_renderer.rs`, `apps/browser/src/capture.rs`, `apps/browser/src/tab.rs`, `wpt/runner/**` — both sides' intent.

5. **Apply the founder's answers W1–W9** exactly as given, each as a named take or undo: W1 the CDP crate, its features, `apps/browser`'s default line; W2 `packages/parley_code_editor`; W3 blitz-net's TLS features and `deny.toml`'s licence; W4 the `skia` / `tiny-skia` default lines; W5–W9 the engine arms named in step 4. A take that adds an env read, a listener or a print site is registered in step 10's census; an undo is a row of step 9's table with the founder's word as its reason.

6. **Upstream's new test files land as targets.** The eight files new against HEAD (`clipboard.rs`, `event_queue.rs`, `native_wheel_data.rs`, `overscroll_behavior.rs`, `pointerdown_cancelled.rs`, `pointerup_cancelled.rs`, `pseudo_document_order.rs`, `wheel_axis_lock.rs`) — and any W-undo's test removed with its change — each its own target; `.github/scripts/test_blitz_tests_targets.py` updated to the merged set; upstream-taken targets kept as taken `(architecture · decision/both-layout-modes)` except. Keeps tests standing S-lines of `tests-standing.md` that name one target per behaviour.

7. **Build to green.** `cargo check --workspace --locked`, then the gates of `## Test Commands` in order. A moved layout, paint or text reading in a stand check is re-measured and re-pinned with the reading recorded (`evidence/readings.md`), never loosened `(test-plan · decision/stand-checks-in-both-layout-modes)`; the incremental oracle holds both modes equal.

8. **The residuals re-read** — `res-q4s3p5ga`, `res-kk4tzmi5`, `res-derughab`, `res-vuvpa25q`, `res-xchmbfjr`, `res-xpkmxnvl`, `res-ipcah32k`, `res-7qgqygtj` — each against the merged tree, its standing or its end recorded in `evidence/readings.md` with the file:line read.

9. **The take and the left-out table** — `evidence/lock.md`: the merge commit's two parents; every upstream commit of `HEAD..547d7514b` whose change the merged tree does not keep, with its reason (a held pin, a founder's undo, a rule of ours, a duplicate already held), the 102 rows of `res-7qgqygtj` re-read one by one (a reason that no longer holds is a commit now taken); the lock read name by name — entered, left, moved — with each new crate reviewed by hand (licence, repository, build script, `unsafe`, proc-macro) and each `deny.toml` ignore's reason re-read.

10. **The sink and surface census** — `evidence/sink.md`: every new `tracing`/`log` call site, target, print and env read in the merged delta over `packages/`, `apps/`, `examples/`, `wpt/` (`git diff --name-only d9af170dcbbabcdfef8b4ddabf3ad49ec3870d4e` with the merge staged, then grep), each against the allowlist sink and the security plan's env list; the standing capture checks at 0 needles.
11. **The stated limits** — `evidence/limits.md`: `position: sticky` not in the take (research §Sticky); Dioxus held, with what waits on it (`res-xpkmxnvl`, `res-xchmbfjr`, `keyboard_compat`).

12. **Operator pass** (entries 11–13 of `## Test Commands`): hygiene, the pre-CI commit — the merge commit, subject `chore(2026-11-19-upstream-sync-ahead-of-the-debts): operator pre-CI commit — merge upstream/main 547d7514b, for the run this chunk's verdict reads` — the push, the CI read. A no-runner cancel of a macOS or iOS job is re-run, never read as green, and noted against WATCH `res-q2tllspz` (inputs#I2).

title: I4-upstream-sync-0.4.0-founder-2026-11-19.md.txt
body:
# The upstream sync of escher 0.4.0 — the founder's answers to its nine boundary widenings, 2026-11-19

Given by three question dialogs in the overseer session, answered by 2026-11-19 19:52Z. The forks are the
builder's `evidence/founder-forks.md` of the chunk `2026-11-19-upstream-sync-ahead-of-the-debts` (W1–W9), the merge
of `upstream/main` at `547d7514b`. Each answer is his chosen label, verbatim, beside the fork's own option letter.
Each question read him what crosses, the rule of ours it meets and each option's cost.

## W1 — the Chrome DevTools Protocol server (a TCP listener with no authentication, on by default in the browser app)
Options: take the crate with devtools off everywhere by default · take as upstream wrote it · undo the CDP chain.
His answer: «Взять, выключено везде (Recommended)»
The fork's option A: the crate and its features merge; `apps/browser`'s default line drops `devtools` and
`embedded-devtools-frontend`; the listener exists only in a build that asks for it; the security plan and
architecture register it as an opt-in listener with no authentication.

## W2 — a second git dependency, `floem-editor-core`, through `parley_code_editor`
Options: leave the crate out of the workspace · take it, widening the no-git rule to a second exception.
His answer: «Оставить крейт вне сборки (Recommended)»
The fork's option A: `packages/parley_code_editor` leaves the workspace members and the tree; no git source beyond
Taffy.

## W3 — TLS through rustls and the platform verifier (`aws-lc-sys`, the licence CDLA-Permissive-2.0)
Options: take · undo, keeping `native-tls`.
His answer: «Взять (Recommended)»
The fork's option A: the new crates reviewed by hand in the lock record, the licence added.

# Collisions survey: trial merge of upstream/main (547d7514b) into build/escher-0.4.0

Read-only. The worktree is `target/tmp/trial-debts` (W). The merge base is 23b9b26a9, and the range holds 212 upstream commits (`git log --oneline 23b9b26a9..upstream/main | wc -l` = 212).
Conflict markers are in two-way style: there is no `|||||||` base section (`grep -c '^|||||||' W/Cargo.toml` = 0). So "ours" means HEAD and "theirs" means upstream.

**Commits the fork already holds.** 76 of the 212 upstream commits carry a `(cherry picked from commit …)` trailer on our branch. Command: `git log --format=%B 23b9b26a9..HEAD | grep -oE 'cherry picked from commit [0-9a-f]{40}'`, intersected with the upstream range.
Other upstream commits came in through squashed sync chunks with no trailer, for example the reversed scroll origins 0980cce5f, the Taffy bumps and the AnyRender 0.15 port. `git cherry` matches 0 of 212 by patch-id. So the full set of upstream commits the fork already holds is **not measurable** from trailers alone.

## Task 1: conflicted files

Counts:
- 52 conflicted files: `git -C W diff --name-only --diff-filter=U`.
- 164 hunks in total, from `grep -c '^<<<<<<< '` per file, summed.
- Status codes: 47 `UU`, 4 `AA`, 1 `UD` (`git -C W status --short`).

Classes: dup = the same change made twice by an earlier pick · text = mechanical to combine · semantic = needs judgement · pin = driven by a dependency move.

Mostly picks that upstream also carries: focus-within, `:open`, font face and size, valign, cellspacing. ## Task 2: Dioxus 0.8.0-alpha.3

**Upstream's API surface.** `git diff HEAD upstream/main --stat -- packages/dioxus-native-dom packages/dioxus-native`: 26 files, +944/−6980.
- Most of the deletions are fork-only escher files that upstream lacks: actionable, boundary, element_id, graph, reached, seed, signal_registry, snapshot, snapshot_diff, snapshot_text, dioxus_document_tests.
- The real upstream changes:
  - `mutation_writer.rs` (647 lines) rewritten as a stack machine: `RealDom` trait, `StackState`, `StackWriter`, `BlitzBackend`.
  - `WriteMutations` methods are now `push_id`, `set_id`, `child`, `pop`, `create_element`, `clone`, `append_children(m)`, `replace_with(m)`, `insert_after/before(m)`, `set_attribute(name, ns, BorrowedAttributeValue)`, `set_text`, `add/remove_event_listener(name)`, `remove`.

  - `keyboard_compat.rs` deleted, because dioxus-html 0.8 shares keyboard-types 0.8.
  - `events.rs`, `lib.rs`, `prelude.rs` changed.
  - dioxus-native gains `config.rs`, `dioxus_application.rs` and `shortcut.rs`: devtools shortcuts (5be96ed0e).

Commits on these paths from 286874cc1 onward (`git log --oneline 286874cc1^..upstream/main -- packages/dioxus-native-dom packages/dioxus-native`): 13, namely 286874cc1, 527394724, 7fc9ee3af, 6ef4b532d, a1670ef1b, d63145027, 5be96ed0e, 74861e747, 67c778deb, b6ace6a0c, 92df4760c, 5d4a1f7b2, 13fa9ace8.

**State in the trial worktree.**
- These files took upstream's 0.8 text cleanly because the fork never edited them since the base (`git diff 23b9b26a9 HEAD --stat` on them is empty): mutation_writer.rs (staged `M`), events.rs (`M`), keyboard_compat.rs (`D`), and dioxus-native's config.rs, dioxus_application.rs, lib.rs, prelude.rs and shortcut.rs.
- So W already mixes upstream's 0.8 writer with the fork's 0.7-era escher modules.

**dioxus-core 0.7.10 against 0.8.0-alpha.3** (registry sources at `~/.cargo/registry/src/*/dioxus-core-*`):
- `Template` is now re-exported from the `dioxus_core_template` crate.
- `TemplateNode` is no longer a dioxus-core export: there is no `pub enum TemplateNode` in src. 0.8 uses `dioxus_core_template::StaticTemplateNode`.
- `VNode` is opaque (`vnode: Rc<VNodeInner>`), so the `.template`, `.dynamic_nodes` and `.roots` fields are not public.
- `BorrowedAttributeValue` is new. `WriteMutations` is a stack machine.
- Unchanged by name: `VirtualDom`, `ScopeId`, `DynamicNode`, `VComponent`, `VText`, `AttributeValue`, `ReactiveContext`, `Subscribers`, `ErrorContext`, `CapturedError`, `provide_create_error_boundary`, `with_root_context`, `new_with_props`, `current_scope_id`, `provide_root_context`, `use_drop`, `use_hook`, `try_consume_context`, `in_scope`, `base_scope`.
- Whether their signatures changed is **not measurable** without a build.

**Escher code hit by the change** (counts from `git grep -cE 'TemplateNode|\bTemplate\b|VNode|DynamicNode|VComponent|WriteMutations|AttributeValue|ElementId|ReactiveContext|Subscribers|Runtime::|ScopeId'`):
- **dioxus-native-dom (fork modules):**
  - `element_id.rs` (21) walks `vnode.template.roots`, `vnode.dynamic_nodes` and `TemplateNode::Element` (L113–155). This breaks on 0.8 and needs a rewrite of the stable-id walk.
  - `mutation_buffer.rs` (36): the fork's file implements 0.7 `WriteMutations`.
  - `dioxus_document.rs` (9), `boundary.rs` (7: ErrorContext, provide_create_error_boundary), `signal_registry.rs` (13: ReactiveContext, Runtime, Subscribers, current_scope_id, use_drop), `graph.rs` (6), `reached.rs` (6), `write_once_attr.rs` (7), `actionable.rs` (via `element_facts(&vdom, &vdom_state, ..)`), `dioxus_document_tests.rs` (6).
- **blitz-test-harness** `harness.rs` (13): `vdom_alone` and the component-alone root build a `VNode` from `Template { roots: &[TemplateNode::Dynamic{..}], node_paths, attr_paths }` (L186–192, L334–341). This breaks on 0.8.
- **escher-driver:** only `dioxus_native_dom::*` escher types (Snapshot, SnapshotDiff, UiGraph, GraphNode, Boundary, ReachedHandler, NodeId, layout types). No direct dioxus-core use, so it is indirectly affected only.
- **seven_guis:**
  - `stand.rs` uses `VirtualDom::new_with_props`, `use_hook`, `provide_context`.
  - `cells.rs` and `crud.rs` use `Key::Enter` from dioxus-html; upstream changed cells.rs to `Key::Named(NamedKey::Enter)`.
  - It also uses `dioxus_core::{ComponentFunction, Properties, CapturedError}`.
  - Names kept, signatures **not measurable**.
- **tests/blitz-tests:** `dioxus_runtime_probe.rs` (8) and `stale_node_mapping.rs` (11; upstream changed it in 286874cc1); 56 `dioxus::prelude::` uses.
- **escher-telemetry:** only target strings (`dioxus_core::runtime`, `dioxus_core::diff::node`, `dioxus_core::scope_arena`, `dioxus_signals::signal`). All four modules still exist in 0.8 (`ls src/`).

**Holding Dioxus 0.7.3: feasible.**
- `git grep -n dioxus upstream/main -- '*Cargo.toml'` shows dioxus deps only in the root manifest, `packages/dioxus-native`, `packages/dioxus-native-dom`, `packages/blitz-test-harness` (dioxus-native-dom, dioxus-core), `tests/blitz-tests` (dioxus, dioxus-core, dioxus-native-dom), `apps/browser` and the examples (counter, seven_guis, todomvc, transparent, wgpu_texture).
- No engine crate (blitz-dom, blitz-traits, blitz-paint, blitz-shell, blitz-net, blitz-html, stylo_taffy, blitz-vibey-*) depends on dioxus.
- Cost:
  - Restore HEAD's dioxus-native(-dom) files and the 0.7 pins.
  - Keep ours on cells.rs, the dioxus_document hunks and mutation_buffer.rs.
  - Hand-port the post-0.8 commits that are not dioxus-API work:
    - 13fa9ace8: wheel phase and source, required because blitz-traits' `BlitzWheelEvent` gains fields.
    - 5d4a1f7b2: dioxus_document flushes the event queue, required with blitz-dom's queue.
    - The renderer cfgs from 67c778deb, 74861e747 and 92df4760c.
    - 527394724: the clipboard feature, needed for winit beta.4 because arboard is gone.
    - Optionally the devtools commits a1670ef1b, d63145027 and 5be96ed0e.
  - Upstream's examples and apps written for 0.8 (browser history, nav, tab and toolbar, todomvc, transforms.rs; 286874cc1 stat) would also stay on our side.

## Task 3: Stylo 0.24

- The fork is on crates.io Stylo **0.22** (`HEAD:Cargo.toml` `style 0.22.0`, `selectors 0.41.0`).
- Upstream went 0.22 → 0.23-pre git (06ecec886), → git rev 2dca345 "0.23.0" (88160ec98), → crates.io 0.24 (2288d67d3: `style 0.24.0`, `selectors 0.43.0`).
- So the delta is two Stylo majors, not one. The 0.23 API is already in conflicted text: `stylo_taffy::CopyStyleGetters` (3 hunks) and `slow_clone_visibility()`, both introduced by 06ecec886 (`git log -S`).
- The 0.23 git pins broke the no-git-dependency invariant, which is why the fork skipped them. 0.24 is crates.io, so it passes that invariant.

Post-0.24 blitz-dom commits: `git log --oneline 2288d67d3..upstream/main -- packages/blitz-dom | wc -l` = **34**.

The 0.24 refactors among them (per-commit `git show --stat`):
- ec0cd2803: presentational hints moved to a module.
- 0124f1b31: Device updated in place (`device_mut().set_media_data`).
- 32797987f, c4fbdc825: UserAgentStylesheet and prefs moved to stylo.
- b003e1c5e: `stylo/` split.
- 342571b9a: inherent Node tree helpers.
- e2d6dc22d: `BlitzNode` newtype, touching document.rs, construct.rs, damage.rs, query_selector.rs and stylo/{dom,mod,traversal}.rs.

Later commits that edit `stylo/*` files directly: 0bdfe4fa3, ea7cfe0e3, fb381be2c, 414b89b59 (presentational hints and svg_attrs). 22 of the 34 touch only non-stylo files: events, scrolling, accessibility, layout, net, serialize, traversal.

**Holding 0.22: feasible only by back-porting.**
- Every post-0.24 commit that touches stylo/, BlitzNode or Device must be re-expressed on the 0.22 single-file `stylo.rs`.
- Pre-0.24 commits that use 0.23 getters must be rewritten too. The fork already does this: per the 2026-11-01 trial log, f6edb9701's test was rewritten as `slow_clone_visibility()` → `.visibility`.
- Whether e2d6dc22d, b003e1c5e and 0124f1b31 strictly need the 0.24 API, rather than being pure refactors: 0124f1b31 uses `Device::set_media_data` and `used_viewport_size`, which are Stylo API. That they are absent in 0.22 is **not measurable** without the 0.22 sources open. b003e1c5e and e2d6dc22d read as structural, so they are likely portable but heavy.
- Taking 0.24 instead resolves `stylo.rs` (UD) by adopting the split and porting the fork's select `size` hint.

## Task 4: standing merge-surface notes

**(a) `handle_click` / pointer.rs.** Touched by 8 upstream commits (`git log 23b9b26a9..upstream/main -- packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs`): 2c76b3f3c, 5d4a1f7b2, c3ef5c86f, 2f8623555, e1c32e379, bb611089c, 0980cce5f, 06ecec886.
- `handle_click`'s body itself: `git log -G 'fn handle_click|handle_click\('` → **5d4a1f7b2** (Queue generated DOM events). It turns every `dispatch_event(DomEvent::new(..))` in the click walk into `doc.queue_ua_event(..)`. The fork had moved that walk into `click_walk` and the private `click_*` fns, so pointer.rs hunks 3 and 4 put upstream's 167-line inline walk against our 467 lines.
- c3ef5c86f and 2f8623555 add `handle_pointerdown` and `handle_pointerup` (hunks 1 and 2); e1c32e379 moves wheel handling to `events/wheel.rs`.
- Resolution: keep the `click_*` split and re-apply the queue conversion inside it. Also apply it to keyboard.rs (`dispatch_activation_click`, select Input) and document.rs blur and focusout.

**(b) clippy `Request::get` ban** (fork-only `packages/blitz-dom/clippy.toml`; `git show upstream/main:packages/blitz-dom/clippy.toml` fails because the file is absent upstream).
- No upstream commit adds a `Request::get` in blitz-dom: `git log -G 'Request::get' -- packages/blitz-dom` returns nothing.
- `git log -S 'stamped_request(' / 'StylesheetHandler {' / 'fetch_font_face' -- packages/` returns nothing, so no new caller was added.
- Upstream's `stamped_request` keeps its 2-arg form `(url, signal)`; ours is 3-arg with `initiator`. W keeps ours: `W/packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:36` reads `Request::get(url).initiator(..)`.
- Related but outside blitz-dom:
  - 7b8712cba (SVG external images) reorganizes `ImageHandler` imports.
  - f6edb9701 adds a `Request::get` in a blitz-net test (blitz-net hunk 3).
  - f0d7aeac9 adds a `CountingNetProvider` test only.
- The ban holds.

**(c) `deallocate_anonymous_block` and `hit_inner`.**
- `deallocate_anonymous_block`: untouched (`git log -G deallocate_anonymous_block 23b9b26a9..upstream/main -- packages/blitz-dom` returns nothing).
- `hit_inner`: `git log -L '/fn hit_inner/,+60:…node.rs'` gives ebacd68bd (picked: trailer present) and **0980cce5f** (reversed scroll origins), whose `matches_self` against `scroll_offset()` collides in node.rs hunk 2 with our `own_x`/`own_y` frame. Our hunk 3 (overflow and `contain: paint` hit stop) is ours alone.
- f99630e1e adds `Node::is_scroll_container` (node.rs hunk 4), which overlaps the fork's private `is_scroll_container` helper in writing_mode.rs.

**(d) `place_floated_box` and the Taffy rev.**
- `place_floated_box`: `git log -G place_floated_box -- packages/blitz-dom/src/layout` → **aa983ec7c** (mid-line float), which introduces `PendingFloat` and `place_inline_float`. It is refined by 8aca42fc3, c5ad75704 and c70a012ba. Collides in inline/layout.rs hunks 2–4.
- Taffy: not moved. upstream/main `Cargo.toml:103` is `rev = "a3997d55bacd1fb6cd12fe31db0be15b20f91528"`, the same as HEAD and W. The last upstream Taffy commit, b4952e15f, set it.

**(e) `mutation_buffer.rs`.** add/add.
- Ours (78 + 45 + 85 lines across 3 hunks) is the port of 286874cc1's buffered render onto 0.7 `WriteMutations` (id-addressed `AppendChildren{id,m}`, `AssignNodeId{path,id}`, `Range<usize>` strings).
- Upstream's records 0.8 stack calls (`PushId`, `SetId`, `StrSpan`).
- It is used by upstream's `DioxusState::apply_buffered_mutations`, which W's auto-merged mutation_writer.rs already expects (`mutation_buffer::MutationBuffer` imported at W L3, field at L247).
- Take upstream's if Dioxus 0.8 is taken; keep ours, plus HEAD's mutation_writer.rs, if 0.7.3 is held.

**(f) `element_removed_before_its_mounted_event_is_flushed` (6ef4b532d).**
- Upstream: `packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:780`, in its inline `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` (`git grep` on upstream/main).
- Not present in HEAD under that name (`git grep` on HEAD returns nothing). Our pick of 6ef4b532d (trailer present) holds `mounted_data_of_removed_element_reports_error` (HEAD dioxus_document.rs:824) instead.
- In W it sits inside dioxus_document.rs hunk 4 (L912), next to a second copy of `task_polled_during_render_can_access_document`; ours is at W:1012.

**Security notes the delta raises** (no other note asked for these):
- a1670ef1b adds `packages/blitz-vibey-cdp-server`, with a `std::net::TcpListener` in `src/transport.rs:10`, behind blitz-shell's `devtools` feature. It is off in dioxus-native's default but on in upstream's browser default (apps/browser hunk). A new listener needs a security-plan amendment first.
- `tungstenite` and `blitz-chrome-devtools-frontend` are new dependencies.
- 5d4a1f7b2 makes vibey pass `event.is_trusted()`. security.md states that every runtime event has `isTrusted = true`.

## Task 5: upstream tests

- `git diff HEAD upstream/main --stat -- tests/` gives 131 files, +837/−35271. Most of the deletions are fork-only tests and checks.
- New files only (`--diff-filter=A`): 8 files, +685, each with its adding commit:
  - clipboard.rs (527394724)
  - event_queue.rs (5d4a1f7b2)
  - native_wheel_data.rs (13fa9ace8)
  - overscroll_behavior.rs (f99630e1e)
  - pointerdown_cancelled.rs (c3ef5c86f)
  - pointerup_cancelled.rs (2f8623555)
  - pseudo_document_order.rs (547d7514b)
  - wheel_axis_lock.rs (bb611089c)
- Edited relative to HEAD:
  - accessibility_hidden.rs (5b8e7a268)
  - stale_node_mapping.rs (286874cc1, Dioxus 0.8)
  - paint_tree_incremental.rs (f9d0e8c76)
  - focusability_updates.rs and accessibility_label.rs (upstream lacks the fork's additions)
  - fragment_navigation.rs (0958b3d4c)
  - render_blocking_stylesheet.rs (Stylo getter)
  - pseudo_element_flow_classification.rs
  - one-line edits to anonymous_block_restyle, pseudo_element_update, stale_dirty_descendants and style_property_invalidation
- Base to upstream: 33 test files touched, and all.rs gains 19 `mod` lines.
- `tests/blitz-tests/Cargo.toml`: no upstream change since the base (`git diff 23b9b26a9 upstream/main -- tests/blitz-tests/Cargo.toml` is empty).
  - Upstream uses one `[[test]]` target, all.rs, with `autotests = false`.
  - The fork drops `autotests = false` and gives all.rs `test = false`, so every file is its own target.
  - The 8 new upstream files therefore become 8 new test targets automatically. `.github/scripts/test_blitz_tests_targets.py` and the stand-repeat or a11y leg lists may need to account for them; check by hand.

title: evidence/founder-forks.md
body:
# Founder's forks — the upstream merge at `547d7514b` (2026-11-19-upstream-sync-ahead-of-the-debts)

Every boundary widening the two-parent merge of `upstream/main` `547d7514b` into `build/escher-0.4.0` brings, collected for the founder in one file, as the operator directed (inputs#I1). None is answered by the phase. Each fork names what crosses, where (upstream `547d7514b` path:line), the rule of ours it meets, whether a test of ours or of the merged delta covers it, whether escher routes agent- or user-supplied input through it today, and the options with what each costs. «Take» means the merge keeps upstream's change as upstream wrote it, recorded PROVISIONAL until ratified (playbook `rul-72xhfjoz`); «undo» means the merge's tree reverses that change, named in the left-out table with this ruling as its reason.

Evidence: `evidence/widenings-survey.md` (the full survey, read-only), `evidence/collisions-survey.md`, research §Boundary widenings.

## W1 — The Chrome DevTools Protocol server: a TCP listener, two env reads, a browser launch
- **What crosses:** `packages/blitz-vibey-cdp-server` (new crate; `a1670ef1b` and six follow-ups). `TcpListener::bind` at `src/transport.rs:29` on `127.0.0.1:{port}`, no Origin check, no authentication: any local process, and any web page able to open `ws://127.0.0.1:PORT`, gets a CDP session. Out: each document's title and URL, the DOM, outer HTML, computed and matched styles. In: `DOM.setOuterHTML`, `DOM.setAttributeValue`, `CSS.setStyleTexts`, `CSS.addRule` and kin — all mutate the live document; `Runtime.evaluate` is a stub. Env reads: `BLITZ_CDP_PORT` (`packages/blitz-shell/src/devtools.rs:61`, starts the listener; a bad value echoed by `eprintln!`) and `BLITZ_DEVTOOLS_FRONTEND_DIR` (`src/frontend.rs:46` serves files of that directory over the socket). `webbrowser` opens the devtools URL and prints it. New registry crates: `tungstenite 0.30`, `blitz-chrome-devtools-frontend 0.1.0` (a 2 MB embedded frontend; its contents not measurable here). Raw protocol messages in warn/trace logs on target `blitz_vibey_cdp_server`.
- **Where it is on:** blitz-shell's `devtools` feature, off by default; `apps/browser`'s default features turn `devtools` and `embedded-devtools-frontend` on (`apps/browser/Cargo.toml:13`), so the `blitz` browser binary would ship it; with it, Dioxus Native apps open devtools on F12 / Cmd+Option+I / Ctrl+Shift+I. seven_guis, escher-driver and the harness name no devtools feature.
- **Our rules it meets:** «The driver session's Unix socket is the one listener: a new socket, port, IPC endpoint or credential path is a security-plan amendment first» (CLAUDE.md); `decision/session-socket-one-listener`, `decision/one-local-unix-listener` (architecture); the env-read list (security §Secrets); residual `res-ipcah32k` (the amendment first, before the take lands); the 2026-10-07 precedent ruled a TCP or UDP port out because it needs an auth surface.
- **Covered by a test:** upstream's own CDP tests (`packages/blitz-vibey-cdp-server/tests/`); none of ours. **Escher routes input through it today:** no.
- **Options:**
  - **A — take the crate, devtools off everywhere by default.** The crate and features merge; `apps/browser`'s default line drops `devtools` and `embedded-devtools-frontend` (an undo of that one line). The listener exists only in a build that asks for it. Security plan and arch §Occupied Resources register it as an opt-in listener with no auth, before the merge lands.
  - **B — take as upstream wrote it.** The browser ships the listener by default, started by `BLITZ_CDP_PORT`. The same registration, as a default-on listener.
  - **C — undo the CDP chain.** The crate, the `devtools` features in blitz-shell, dioxus-native, apps and examples, and the follow-ups are reversed in the merge's tree; every later upstream edit to them is undone too at each future merge.

## W2 — A second git dependency: `floem-editor-core` through `parley_code_editor`
- **What crosses:** `packages/parley_code_editor/Cargo.toml:21` `floem-editor-core = { git = "https://github.com/lapce/floem", rev = "1351ffb162faeb8be983f1301d718a0d5fb59c27" }` (`60c3baffd`). The crate is a workspace member nothing depends on (`publish = false`), but every `--workspace` build and the lockfile take the git source, its lock entry with no checksum; it also brings `syntaxmate =0.3.0`.
- **Our rules it meets:** «The workspace takes no git dependency — every crate a crates.io registry version, the taffy crate alone excepted» (CLAUDE.md); `decision/no-git-dependency`, `decision/no-git-dependencies`, `decision/upstream-sync-dependency-set` («git content only by Taffy's own pin»).
- **Covered by a test:** upstream's own; none of ours. **Escher routes input through it:** no.
- **Options:**
  - **A — leave the crate out of the workspace.** `packages/parley_code_editor` is removed from the members and its files from the tree (an undo of `60c3baffd` and `1a7ec714e`); no git source beyond Taffy.
  - **B — take it, widening the no-git rule to a second exception** (floem at a full rev, integrity on the rev, through the lock, audit and MSRV legs).

## W3 — TLS through rustls and the platform verifier
- **What changes:** `62715e975` drops `native-tls` from blitz-net's reqwest for every target but Android; certificate checks for every remote fetch go through rustls with `rustls-platform-verifier`. New lock crates `aws-lc-rs`, `aws-lc-sys` (a C library built at compile time), `rustls-platform-verifier`, `rustls-native-certs`, `webpki-root-certs`; `deny.toml` gains the licence `CDLA-Permissive-2.0`.
- **Our rules it meets:** security §Dependencies («still review new crates by hand»), `decision/licence-gate` (upstream's licence table held byte for byte).
- **Covered by a test:** no test of ours fetches over TLS. **Escher routes input through it:** no agent- or user-supplied URL (security §Untrusted input).
- **Options:** **A — take** (the new crates reviewed by hand in the lock record, the licence added) · **B — undo**, keeping `native-tls`.

## W4 — Skia built by default in the browser and the WPT runner
- **What changes:** `74861e747` makes `skia` a default feature of `apps/browser`; `e7cca1d37` / `ea07ee716` add `tiny-skia` and `skia` to `wpt/runner`'s defaults. A `--workspace` build then compiles `skia-bindings 0.157.0`, whose build script normally downloads prebuilt binaries over the network at build time (not measurable here — its source is not in the local registry). New registry crate `anyrender_tiny_skia 0.1.0`.
- **Our rules it meets:** security §Dependencies (locked, reviewed builds); every CI cargo leg `--locked`.
- **Options:** **A — take** (the CI legs then build skia; a build-time network fetch measured in the take) · **B — undo the default lines**, skia stays an opt-in feature.

## W5 — Focus changes fire DOM events (an engine change for every document)
- **What changes:** `5d4a1f7b2`, `2c76b3f3c`, `b4ad543de` queue generated DOM events on the document; `BaseDocument::clear_focus` (upstream `document.rs:1821`) now queues `blur` and `focusout`, `set_focus_to` (`:1847`) `blur`, `focusout`, `focus`, `focusin`. Programmatic focus (`element.focus()`, autofocus, a driver `type` on a select) then fires them to page scripts and app handlers.
- **Our rules it meets:** `decision/inert-focus-clear-silent` («A node that loses focus by coming under `inert` fires no DOM `blur` or `focusout`», security; guard `inert_subtree`); `decision/driver-type-on-select` («focuses it with no click and no DOM focus events»); `decision/focus-fixup-without-events` (architecture).
- **Covered by a test:** upstream's `event_queue.rs`, `focus_redraw.rs`; ours `inert_subtree`, `select_interaction`, `stand_act_select` read the silences. **Escher routes input through it:** yes — the driver's `type` on a select focuses through this path.
- **Options:**
  - **A — take the queue, keep the two ratified silences:** the inert clear and the driver's select focus stay silent (fork exceptions beside upstream's queue); every other focus change fires as upstream wrote it.
  - **B — take whole:** the two silences end; the two rows and their tests are re-ratified to upstream's behaviour.
  - **C — undo the focus events,** keeping the queue for the other events.

## W6 — Script-dispatched events read `isTrusted = false`
- **What changes:** `5d4a1f7b2` adds `EventDispatchSource {Input, UserAgent, Script}`; an event a page script dispatches reads `isTrusted = false` (upstream `blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/event.rs:243-244`). A narrowing in effect, but it changes a recorded fact.
- **Our rule it meets:** security §Untrusted input — «every runtime event has `isTrusted = true`».
- **Options:** **A — take** (the recorded fact re-stated) · **B — undo**.

## W7 — A cancelled mouse pointerup still clicks
- **What changes:** `2f8623555`, `c3ef5c86f`: a page that `preventDefault()`s a mouse `pointerup` still gets a Click (`events/pointer.rs:577`, `do_click = … !default_prevented || event.is_mouse()`), so `handle_click` runs — a checkbox or radio toggles with its `change`, a button submits, a link navigates.
- **Our rules it meets:** security §Untrusted input, the keyboard-activation and checkable-`change` paragraphs; residual `res-vuvpa25q` (the `click_*` arm functions).
- **Covered by a test:** upstream's `pointerup_cancelled.rs`, `pointerdown_cancelled.rs`. **Escher routes input through it:** the driver's `click` synthesises mouse events through this path.
- **Options:** **A — take** · **B — undo**.

## W8 — SVG presentation attributes and `hr` attributes read as style hints
- **What changes:** `ea7cfe0e3`, `414b89b59`, `0bdfe4fa3` read about 45 SVG presentation attributes as CSS through a typed parse (`stylo/svg_attrs.rs`, `stylo/presentational_hints.rs:540`); `fb381be2c` reads `hr`'s `color`, `noshade`, `size`. `mask`, `filter` and `clip-path` take `url(…)`: whether an SVG `mask="url(…)"` reaches the existing mask-image fetch (through the stamping constructor, under the `file:` refusal) is not measurable read-only — measured at the take.
- **Our rule it meets:** security §Untrusted input, the presentational-hints paragraph (a typed parse, a value that does not parse ignored — ratified for `font`, `valign`, `cellspacing`, `cellpadding`).
- **Options:** **A — take** (the `mask` reach measured and recorded) · **B — undo**.

## W9 — `visibility: collapse` leaves the accessibility tree and the snapshot
- **What changes:** `5b8e7a268` excludes `visibility: collapse` as well as `hidden` (`accessibility.rs:194`, `!= Visible`), so such an element leaves the platform adapter's tree and escher's snapshot. A narrowing of what leaves; it changes the snapshot's node set for every document.
- **Our rule it meets:** security §Untrusted input, the accessibility builder's two exits (the adapter and the snapshot).
- **Covered by a test:** upstream's edit to `accessibility_hidden.rs` (in the a11y leg). **Escher routes input through it:** the snapshot.
- **Options:** **A — take** · **B — undo**.

## Not forks — the phase leans these by our own rules (shown for completeness)
- The unpinned `nttld/setup-ndk@v1` in upstream's `ci.yml`: pinned to its 40-hex SHA (`decision/ci-actions-pinned-to-sha`, `WorkflowPinTest`).
- Upstream's `AGENTS.md`: kept out (`decision/upstream-agents-md-excluded`).
- `README.md`: escher's version (`decision/readme-is-escher-own`).
- The stamped sub-resource request: kept, `f0d7aeac9`'s `@import` refusal applied through it (`decision/one-stamping-request-constructor`).
- The runtime's checkbox/radio `change` synthesis: stays deleted, the engine's `change` alone (security §Untrusted input).
- The ratified changed set (`changed_nodes` / `take_changed_nodes`): kept, upstream's `has_changes` / `clear_changes` read from it (`decision/accessibility-tree-refresh-on-change`).
- Dioxus held at 0.7.3 (intent finding 4: «One that hangs on another's release (RUSTSEC, Dioxus 0.8) is stated as such, not forced»), Stylo 0.24 · parley 0.13 · skrifa 0.49 · winit beta.4 taken as one coupled registry set (`decision/upstream-sync-dependency-set`) — a dependency set, not a widening; the operator rules it at P5.

title: evidence/limits.md
body:
# Stated limits of the take — 2026-11-19-upstream-sync-ahead-of-the-debts

## `position: sticky` (blitz#887) is not in the take
- No commit of `HEAD..547d7514b` builds a scroll-relative sticky offset (research §Sticky): `git log -S'Sticky' HEAD..547d7514b` finds `f9d0e8c76` alone, a paint-order change.
- In the merged tree a sticky box is classed with `relative` for paint order and stacking and is laid out as `relative`: `packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs` maps Stylo `Sticky` to `taffy::Position::Sticky`, which the engine reads beside `Relative`; `packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs` reads no sticky.
- So a `position: sticky` box scrolls away with its scroller, as before the merge.

## Dioxus held at 0.7.3 (lock: 0.7.10)
- The merge keeps upstream's coupled registry set (Stylo 0.24 · selectors 0.43 · parley 0.13 · skrifa 0.49 · winit `=0.31.0-beta.4` · svgtypes 0.16.2) and holds Dioxus at `0.7.3` in the root manifest, `0.7.10` in the lock, as at HEAD.

- What waits on Dioxus 0.8:
  - `res-xpkmxnvl` — upstream's `element_removed_before_its_mounted_event_is_flushed` (upstream `packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:780`) returns only with the 0.8 `dioxus_document.rs`; our pick's `mounted_data_of_removed_element_reports_error` stands in its place.
  - `res-xchmbfjr` — `packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_buffer.rs` stays escher's port of the buffered render onto 0.7's id-addressed `WriteMutations`; upstream's 0.8 stack-machine buffer comes with the move.
  - `keyboard_compat.rs` — upstream's keyboard-types 0.7/0.8 bridge stays in dioxus-native-dom (and stays excluded by name from the coverage leg) until dioxus-html shares keyboard-types 0.8.
  - The stable-id walk (`element_id.rs`, `vnode.template.roots` / `TemplateNode::Element`) and the harness's `vdom_alone` are re-built against 0.8's opaque `VNode` at the move.

# The take and the left-out table — 2026-11-19-upstream-sync-ahead-of-the-debts

## The merge
- Form: a two-parent merge, `git -c rerere.enabled=false merge --no-commit --no-ff 547d7514ba2adb357d41d5e4655a63ddd5cdc5ec` on `build/escher-0.4.0`. The merge commit is the operator's pre-CI commit.
- `git rev-list --count d9af170dc..547d7514b` = 212 upstream commits. 52 conflicted files on the real merge, as on the trial.
- Every upstream commit of the range is an ancestor of the merge. "Left out" below means its change is undone, whole or in part, in the merged tree.

## Left out — whole or in part, each with its reason
| Commit | Subject | What the merged tree undoes | Reason |

- RUSTSEC-2026-0370 · 0371 · 0372 `zvariant` / `zbus_names` / `zvariant_derive` ← `zbus 5.19.0` ← `accesskit_unix` — now `0.24.1`; the reasons' text names `0.24.0` (re-written likewise), stands.
- RUSTSEC-2026-0459 `libsqlite3-sys 0.30.1` ← `rusqlite 0.32.1` ← `browser-persistence` — stands.

## Skia's build-time fetch (the founder's W4 «Взять как в upstream», measured)
- `skia-bindings 0.157.0` (← `skia-safe 0.157.0` ← `anyrender_skia 0.13.0` ← `apps/browser`'s and `wpt/runner`'s default `skia`) runs a build script that, at build time, runs the host's `curl` (`build_support/binary_cache/utils.rs:55`) to download prebuilt binaries from `https://github.com/rust-skia/skia-binaries/releases/download/{tag}/skia-binaries-{key}.tar.gz` (`build_support/binary_cache/env.rs:23`).
- Measured on this host at the merge's first workspace check (`target/debug/build/skia-bindings-77b2029b6194a881/output`, 2026-11-19 21:05 local): `TRYING TO DOWNLOAD AND INSTALL SKIA BINARIES: 0.157.0/30669978c3f39a73e8a7-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-ganesh-gl-jpegd-jpege-pdf`, `FROM: https://github.com/rust-skia/skia-binaries/releases/download/0.157.0/skia-binaries-30669978c3f39a73e8a7-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-ganesh-gl-jpegd-jpege-pdf.tar.gz`, `DOWNLOAD AND INSTALL SUCCEEDED`; the unpacked output 30 MB.
- No checksum or signature check of the download was found in `build_support/binary_cache` (no hash compared against the archive); the key in the file name is the binaries' configuration hash, not a content digest. Without the download the build script falls back to a full Skia source build (`download_dependencies` through `git`).
- So every `--workspace` build and every CI leg that builds `apps/browser` or `wpt/runner` fetches unreviewed native code from the network at build time — the cost the founder chose with W4.

# Residuals re-read against the merged tree, and moved readings

The merged tree: `build/escher-0.4.0` at `d9af170dc` with `MERGE_HEAD` `547d7514b` staged, resolved by this run. Lines are the working tree's at this run's end.

The mask-image fetch an SVG `mask` attribute reaches goes through it too (`packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/damage.rs`, `flush_image_layers_from_style`; W8 below). | stands — no constructor outside `stamped_request` |
| `res-kk4tzmi5` (`deallocate_anonymous_block`, `hit_inner`) | `deallocate_anonymous_block` (`packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1576`) reads byte-equal to HEAD's. `hit_inner` (`packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1486`) keeps escher's `own_x`/`own_y` frame (`:1546`), equal in effect to upstream `0980cce5f`'s scroll-offset bounds, and its overflow and `contain: paint` stop (`:1639`, `clone_contain` now read through upstream's `CopyStyleGetters`). `f99630e1e` adds the public `Node::is_scroll_container` (`node.rs:2184`) beside escher's private, styles-safe `is_scroll_container` in `packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/writing_mode.rs:487`, which the scrolled-box bounds keep. | stands |
| `res-derughab` (Taffy rev, `place_floated_box`) | Taffy's rev `a3997d55bacd1fb6cd12fe31db0be15b20f91528` unchanged (`Cargo.toml:107`). `packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/inline/layout.rs` reads byte-equal to upstream's at `547d7514b` (`git diff 547d7514b -- …inline/layout.rs` empty): `aa983ec7c`'s `PendingFloat` / `place_inline_float` (`:150`) taken, `place_floated_box` called from it (`:167`). | stands, its float chain now upstream's |
| `res-vuvpa25q` (`handle_click`'s arms) | `5d4a1f7b2` turned every dispatch into `queue_ua_event`; escher's walk keeps its split — `handle_click` (`packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:798`), `click_walk` (`:817`), `click_element` (`:854`) and the arms `click_checkbox` (`:895`), `click_radio` (`:917`), `click_summary` (`:952`), `click_select` (`:977`), `click_option` (`:994`), `click_label` (`:1012`), `click_link` (`:1035`), `click_select_row` (`:1116`), `click_button` (`:1145`) — each re-applied by hand to the queue model: an event queued with `doc.queue_ua_event`, a focus through `doc.set_focus_to`, which now queues its own focus events. | stands — the hand re-apply recurs at each sync that edits an arm |
| `res-xchmbfjr` (`mutation_buffer.rs`) | `packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_buffer.rs` byte-equal to HEAD's (Dioxus held, `evidence/limits.md`). | stands, moves only with Dioxus 0.8 |
| `res-xpkmxnvl` (upstream's removed-element mounted test) | upstream's `element_removed_before_its_mounted_event_is_flushed` lives in its 0.8 `dioxus_document.rs`, not taken; our pick's `mounted_data_of_removed_element_reports_error` stands (`packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:850`). | stands, moves only with Dioxus 0.8 |
| `res-ipcah32k` (the CDP listener) | in the take as an opt-in listener: `packages/blitz-vibey-cdp-server/src/transport.rs:29` `TcpListener::bind`, reached only under blitz-shell's `devtools` feature, which no default turns on (W1 A; `evidence/sink.md`). Its security-plan and arch §Occupied Resources registration is the wrap's amendment. | its precondition (the amendment before the take lands) is the wrap's, before the operator's pre-CI commit |
| `res-7qgqygtj` (the 102 left out at `e5305a4c1`) | re-read row by row in `evidence/lock.md` §The 102 re-read. | ends — every row's change is now in the merged tree or named again with its reason there |

## W8 — an SVG `mask="url(…)"`'s reach (the founder's «Взять, путь mask измерить»)
- Path read: `packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo/svg_attrs.rs` maps the SVG `mask` presentation attribute to the CSS `mask` shorthand through a typed parse; a URL it names is a `mask-image` layer; `flush_image_layers_from_style` (`packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/damage.rs`) fetches a style image through `crate::net::stamped_request(…, &self.url)`, stamping the loading document as the initiator, so blitz-net's `file:` refusal applies. No other constructor exists in blitz-dom (`res-q4s3p5ga` above).
- Measured by the check `tests/blitz-tests/tests/svg_mask_attribute_fetch.rs`, both layout modes:
  - `mask="url(file:///stamp/mask.png)"` on a page at `http://remote.test/page.html` is fetched once, its request's `initiator` the page — through the stamping constructor, under the `file:` refusal. No stop (the founder's condition was a mask round the constructor).
  - A fragment-only `mask="url(#m)"`, naming the page's own `<mask id="m">`, is **also fetched**, once, as `data:text/css;charset=utf-8;base64,#m`, stamped with the page: the SVG attribute parse is given the default document URL as its base (`packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo/presentational_hints.rs`, the `ns!(svg)` `url_extra_data` of `DocumentUrl::default()`), so the fragment resolves against that empty `data:` URL instead of the page. A spurious sub-resource request per fragment mask, upstream's behaviour since `ea7cfe0e3`; recorded as a measured fact on the operator's word (inputs#I8) and flagged upstreamable. The check pins the reading.

## W4 — skia's build-time fetch (the founder's «Взять как в upstream»)
Recorded in `evidence/lock.md` §Skia's build-time fetch.

## The inline box no font can shape (an upstream defect, fixed here — inputs#I7, inputs#I8)
- Found through `font_face_sniffed_source` (red in `fast`, gate entry 6, first firing). Parley 0.13 places an in-flow inline box at a U+FFFC placeholder in its parent's text; where no family of the parent resolves a font, the placeholder is not shaped, the line holds no inline-box item, and the box is never placed (its layout stays 0×0). The web font of that check loads, registers and shapes its own text (content width 0 → 115.5 at 20px) the whole time.
- Upstream reading: the witness `packages/blitz-dom/src/document_inline_box_placeholder_tests.rs` run on a clone at `547d7514b` (`target/tmp/upstream-547d`, the same file under `document.rs`): `the inline-block takes the width of its text in the loaded font (incremental: false)` — red, the precondition (width 0 before the font) holding. At HEAD (parley 0.12) `font_face_sniffed_source` read green.
- Fix: `packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/inline/build.rs` `push_inline_box` shapes an in-flow box's placeholder in its parent's families with `crate::PLACEHOLDER_FONT_FAMILY` (`blitz-inline-box-placeholder`) last; `BaseDocument::new` registers `crate::BULLET_FONT` under that family in every document's font context, a given one included, when the family is absent. The bullet font covers U+0020, U+2022, U+25AA, U+25B8, U+25BE, U+25C2, U+25E6 and no U+FFFC (`fc-query`), and no other lookup names the family. Flagged upstreamable.
- Witness control: with the fallback family's push removed, the witness reads red (`test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed`); restored byte-identical (sha256 equal), green.

## Moved readings
None re-pinned by this run: the stand checks' readings are those of `fast` (entry 6) and `stand-repeat` (entry 10) as fired; a moved reading would be listed here with its old and new value.

body:
# Sink and surface census — the merged delta against `d9af170dc`

Read: `git diff d9af170dcbbabcdfef8b4ddabf3ad49ec3870d4e -- packages apps examples wpt` over the staged merge, test files left out (`*/tests/*`, `*_tests.rs`), every added line matched for a `tracing`/`log` macro, a print (`println!` · `eprintln!` · `print!` · `eprint!` · `dbg!`), an env read (`env::var` · `env::var_os` · `env!` · `option_env!`) and a listener (`TcpListener` · `UdpSocket` · `UnixListener` · `bind(`). 31 hits; each below with its class.

The escher sink (`packages/escher-telemetry/src/format.rs`) drops a target outside `ENGINE_TARGET_PREFIXES` (`blitz` · `dioxus_native` · `stylo_taffy` · `accesskit_xplat` · `debug_timer` · `js_console`) and `ESCHER_TARGET_PREFIXES` (`escher_`), and prints only `SAFE_FIELDS` of an engine target — the message redacted. Every new tracing target below is a crate path under `blitz` (`blitz_dom::…`, `blitz_shell::…`, `blitz_vibey_cdp_server::…`), so each reaches the sink as an engine record, its message redacted; none is an `escher_*` target.

## Log sites (tracing)
| Site | Target class | Reaches an escher binary? |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/blitz-dom/src/events/driver.rs:407` `tracing::warn!` (the queue's per-flush bound, a fixed text and a constant) | engine, message redacted | yes, behind blitz-dom's `tracing` feature |
| `packages/blitz-shell/src/application.rs:85` `tracing::error!` (a clipboard write failed) | engine, message redacted | the windowed shell only |
| `packages/blitz-vibey-cdp-server/src/frontend.rs:61`, `src/lib.rs:129`, `:214`, `:215`, `:217`, `:404`, `src/session/mod.rs:197`, `src/transport.rs:32`, `:43`, `:178`, `:224`, `:228` — the CDP server's own records, raw protocol messages among them at warn/trace | engine, message redacted | no: the crate builds only under blitz-shell's `devtools` feature, which no default turns on after W1 A and which seven_guis, escher-driver and the harness never name |

## Prints
| Site | Reaches an escher binary? |
|---|---|
| `packages/blitz-shell/src/devtools.rs:65`, `:103`, `:108`, `:115`, `:122` — `eprintln!` of the CDP launcher (a bad `BLITZ_CDP_PORT` echoed; the devtools URL printed) | no: `devtools.rs` is `#[cfg(feature = "devtools")]`, off by default everywhere (W1 A) |
| `wpt/runner/src/main.rs:347` `println!` (the renderer's name) · `wpt/runner/src/renderer.rs:88` `eprintln!` | no: the WPT runner, upstream's own binary |
| `packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo/traversal.rs:115` `// dbg!(root);` | a comment, no print |

## Env reads
| Site | Reached by |
|---|---|
| `packages/blitz-shell/src/devtools.rs:61` `std::env::var("BLITZ_CDP_PORT")` — starts the CDP listener | the `devtools` feature alone (opt-in, W1 A) |
| `packages/blitz-vibey-cdp-server/src/frontend.rs:27`, `:45` `std::env::var_os("BLITZ_DEVTOOLS_FRONTEND_DIR")` — serves that directory's files over the CDP socket | the `devtools` feature alone |

Both are new env reads outside the security plan's list (security §Secrets); neither reads a secret, and neither is compiled into an escher binary by default. Their registration is the wrap's security-plan amendment with W1's (the opt-in listener), not this run's.

## Listeners
| Site | Reached by |
|---|---|
| `packages/blitz-vibey-cdp-server/src/transport.rs:29` `TcpListener::bind(&addr)` on `127.0.0.1:{BLITZ_CDP_PORT}`, no Origin check, no authentication | blitz-shell's `devtools` feature alone: off in every default after W1 A (`git grep -n '^default' -- '*Cargo.toml'` names no `devtools` feature) |

The `rebind` hits (`lib.rs:144`, `:196`, `:228`, `session/mod.rs:189`) are a method name, no listener; `transport.rs:10` is the `TcpListener` import of the row above.

## The standing capture checks
`host_log`, `mcp_log` (seven_guis) and escher-telemetry's own format tests run inside the `fast` leg (entry 6) and `stand-repeat` (entry 10); their reading is recorded with those entries' lines in this run's outcome.
